claims.source_title: Machinery Milestones: History of the combine harvester
claims.supporting_quote: Credit for producing the first Californian combines usually goes to Daniel Best’s company, which started production in about 1885 – narrowly ahead of the Holt brothers, who are said to have built their first harvesters in 1886.

claims.claim: Holt and Best merged in 1926 to form Caterpillar Tractor Company.
claims.supporting_quote: In 1926 Best and Holt merged to form the Caterpillar tractor company.
